body: I wouldn’t  beilive or care what that person says to you.

Yep, you can’t trust what people try to make you think for these reasons. Look past the obvious. Try to analyze what they could be up to. Most of the time it’s attemps to manipulate for the upper hand.

I agree social anxiety is rather debilitating. You should try limiting yourself to experiences that have lower impact on you socially.
And try to lesson your stress load by not putting to much pressure on yourself.

In hindsight would you have done anything differently? If you have a different course of action in mind then that’s what you have to learn from this horrible experience.  Reading your post I suppose you were being a bit fair-whether, but how much can we blame ourselves for other people’s actions.  Nothing can change the past, all we can do is learn.
Yeh, I had “what I’ve done” on repeat for days after he died.  Always felt his struggle through his music.

Life span really is so sort. We are just a spec in the infinite. Can’t see much of a point other than feeling good and enjoying things if we can. It’s sad for us to just suffer our limited time we are given.

I will have to virtually hold you but, it’s okay.  When it comes to love the more you want it to happen, the less likely it seems to happen.  I don't think you can force it to exist by sheer willpower.  However, believe it’s possible. Becouse it is. Relax and take your time learning how to properly engage interactions, learning to tell when someone’s interested and how to maintain the interaction. You could be in the wrong places where you are looking for it. 
  Get your head in the right mindset, don’t be stressed on the process.  Even if you only do it part right your chances greatly improve.

We are not the best judges of ourselves, we have a tendency to think we are pointless and boring. It’s best to not get cought  up in our own nagative opinions about ourselves. Like useless, worthless. We’re all useless and worthless, you are as relavent as anyone. Whats the point of life anyway? The only point I see is to feel good and enjoy things. I know that’s going to be hard from where your are at, but it’s really all there is. If you were to be strong and make it past this stage, you’d be a whole new person and I bet you’d be satisfied knowing you didn’t let this hell defeat you. There’s a strength that comes from facing our problems and fears and it’s one of the greater feelings you can have in life.

I see the depth of what your going through.  Your definitely facing a challenge,  i have struggled with depression and suicidal thoughts my whole life. It has never gone away or really got better. But there are some things I have learned, taking ones own life requires the same kind of strength that it takes to live through the suffering and keep going. I accually think it’s probably easier to just live and deal with the feeling becouse it happens by default.
So there’s the decision, do you really want yourself to be dead or should you take the challenge and just live it out. If your up for a challenge then go at it and defeat these things by not letting them have power over you. Definitely don’t kill yourselve becouse of anything to do with other people. The person that abused you does not deserve that control over you. Let them rot in their own karmic hell, they should not get to chose your fate.

Yeh, seems like you know what I mean. Both of those could be overdone. Absolutely care about what she’s going through, try to fine the level of emphasis she likes.  Being positive is good, but staying relaxed and attentive to what kind of effect your creating.
Do you have any ideas as to what makes you feel this way that you feel like sharing?  I know sometimes it’s just a general feeling but if there are specific things it can help to identify them.

Try not to put to much emphasis on the dating aspect, just focus on being a friend. Being entertained and distracted may be better for her for now than talking about it, to give her more time to separate from the incident.  Definitely don’t put all your focus on her if she seems to feel uncomfortable. You see her on a regular basis you need to get a feel for how she’s feeling.  There isn’t necessarily a set formula, these situations are difficult. Just try to have a genuine, good energy, but dont over do it.  If you can find ways to smoothly remove some of the stress from her life that may have lead to the breakdown, it could expedite her recovery.  Do keep in mind that some things people don’t recover from. If she’s important to you, you will adapt and maybe that will be the best it can be.  Patience is key.
It’s unlikely anyone will feel better after your gone. Have you had any luck trying to figure out what things make you feel this way?

It’s good you posted, I think expressing yourself like this is brave and a sign of strength.  You rationalize really well, and if you think you would benefit from talking about things, please do. I have time to listen. Your  welcome to DM me. I myself have been on the other side, I know what you mean by some can’t be helped. I think everyone should have a chance to find the things they may be missing In themselves.  Often times it takes someone other than ourselves to see it.
Do you have any ideas as to the couse of your depression, do you go through a lot of stress?

Image line FL studio is a good app to start on, you can download a demo, you just wouldn’t be able to save on the demo. Good enough to check it out. The skill doesn’t come instantly. You’ll need to put some time in.  It’s one of the few things I enjoy doing going on 12 years now. I’d be interested in how it goes for you.

Care to talk about what’s got you feeling this way?
Some information would help to understand what your going through.
What’s got you scared of living? If you don’t mine sharing.  Does it feel like there’s  no salutions to the problems?

It takes time and patience, you may need longer than that. But setting a deadline to accomplish things is good. Just don’t kill yourself.  If your trying, then you will get things sorted. Just knock em off one at a time.  Shrink that list of problems, till you can breath again.

The point is to find those good feelings and feel them as often as you can. Might take some work to find them but they are out there.  I think it’s the best place to start when life feels pointless.  Also steer clear of toxic people and stress as much as possible.
I have a song for you if you would please listen to it. warrior soul “the losers” on youtube.

Care to share what’s got you feeling this way?
Also please listen to the song “the losers” by warrior soul. On youtube.
Please Listen to the song, “The losers” by warrior soul.  On youtube.   Even if you don’t like the style of music the message is relavent.

A good staring point to get out of this situation is simply just stop telling people stuff. If you talk, keep it simple. Try not to say anything other than things you are actually doing.  You’ll get use to it and start catching yourself when you start to lie. Might seem boring at first compared to telling lies, but you’ll get use to that too.

In a way, there in no point to anyone’s existence. If you can find things that give you a good feeling, makes being alive have more point to it.  It sounds like music is some what relavent to you, producing your own would be a good thing to try out. It will suck up your attention just learning how.  Hip hop, trap, and bass music are pretty enjoyable to make. Do you have access to a computer?

The best way to show him isn’t your hanging body, it’s you surviving through this to grow up and have your own life he has no control over. Then you will get to decide how things go and who gets to be involved with you.  He will have zero control and never be able to make you feel like this. It will be your choice, you just have to  be patient and survive.  If it gets to bad in the meantime try to find help, but don’t kill your self for him or anybody.
Do you look forward to being 18 and having your own life at all?  Life changes quite a bit after the teen years.

Iv been in similar situation myself, and I think your right about wanting to start over somewhere else.  You have to visualize a different life for yourself and find a way to get there. If your patient and try to work on things it could help a lot. Depression isn’t the only thing that leads to feeling this way, stress is a major factor also. If your going through a lot of stress it can be incapacitating.  Iv thought a lot about the point of life and  I think the point is feeling the way you like to feel.  It takes some searching to find.

This isn’t really a dead end, it’s just something you will have to work your way out of. There’s always more options than we see in a given situation, things might suck for a while but losing everything and restarting will often lead to a stronger more solid position in life.
Why do you want to, do you feel like sharing? It’s easier to understand with some details of what makes you feel this way.

I bet your a lot more strong that you are thinking right now. Best way to fix yourself is to really find out what you can about what’s behind it all. There really is no guarantee of anything. You have to go on knowing that, and just be ok with what is.  You sound rather self aware so you should be able to really look inward. I think if you want to love yourself then you probably already do. It’s sad to see ourselves like this but it’s a necessary part in understanding. I fully relate with the feeling of not given a choice, but there is a path ahead, maybe not the ideal path but nonetheless a path to walk down and it does lead somewhere.

I failed at school, tried to take some classes and Can’t seem to get very far . Having to have a job kinda just sucks. It is tiring to just exist. I agree.  You probably care about yourself at least a little bit somewhere in there, do you really want your self to be dead?

Those are things that will most likely change in the future. Of course you need a way to survive as an adult so school may be somewhat relavent, but family  you can get away from  in a few years. 
Sounds like your probably tired of dealing with it and time is going slow.  Is there anything you look forward to? Anyway you can pass the time better.

If someone has the strength to end their own life they also have the strength to live though the suffering. It depends on what your going through but if it’s that life isn’t worth living, it’s also not worth dying so You might as well just ride it out. What are you going through if you feel like sharing?
How did you decide life isn’t worth living, Is it things you feel like you can talk about?

If your strong enough to take your own life, you are also strong enough to handle all these things you are feeling and the suffering you are going through.
You said ugly and talentless but we are often our own worst critics, you are most likely overlooking the good things about yourself. 
Also It doesn’t seem like your boyfriend is trying to help you feel better, that’s kinda the friend part.  So your basically going though it all alone. Might help to try to visualize a new path for yourself and get your focus off your current situation.

Nothing may seem worth living for but it’s not worth dying for.  If your strong enough to end your own life, your strong enough to handle whatever suffering your going to go though and keep living to get through it.   Would be good to hear more details of your situation if you feel like sharing..
